title: Quantum Modular Forms and Resurgence
note: arXiv:2505.00799 (May 2025). Median-resummation results showing holomorphic quantum modular forms are recovered from their (or closely related) divergent asymptotics, given the extra datum of an L-function with a functional equation whose coefficients are the Stokes constants (extending the Fantini–Rella program) — the recovery engine behind the QOU Watson/median-Borel uniqueness chain. Figure-eight (4₁) J-function is the worked example. Registered 2026-08-01 (c₃-via-Borel literature sweep).
